author: Revcheck
body:
Recently, a friend of mine (MAK_Gaming) was banned permanently for seemingly no reason. This was done by a moderator with the name FrostedCupcakez on account of "no slowdown", although I have not the slightest idea what that might be. My friend claims that he was simply experiencing lag, and was not using unorthodox methods by any means. He would like this ban removed from his account.

If it is any help (although, I would assume it is not,) this unfortunate event took place on November 11, 2015, and at approximately two o'clock.




-Revcheck on behalf of MAK_Gaming

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
I do not see hacks in the video provided. It could either be a visual glitch, exploitation of a glitch, or anything else that could have made it look similar. With the alternation between sprinting and walking, and the coordination of the bow being drawn, and the inaccuracy of judging solely off this hack for a ban, I am going to appeal this. It's also not that sufficient for something that could be suspected as that.


Regards,
ViceWatercolour.
